    • About Prismatic.

    Prismatic is Michael and Andrew Gioia, brothers, designers, and developers with a combined 50+ years of experience making software.

    We’ve worked together for more than 18 years. Prismatic is where we build the software, games, and other products we wish were available—purposefully, carefully, and with respect for the people using them.
